source: honest reference recorded on 8xH100 (TP=8), vLLM 0.28.0.dev0+glm53.gonka.sampler1, gonka-poc 0.1.4, gpu-mem 0.95, collection batch 16, seed s1
notes: stat_test mirrors the chain consensus params proposed for this model (dist_threshold=4.4e-1, p_mismatch=1e-1, p_value_threshold=5e-2). TP=8 was chosen as the reference topology because it is the only arm where the first-in-batch instability is absent: two honest runs of this seed differ in 1 of 1000 nonces here, against 63 of 1000 on 4xH200 and 4xB200. Validating a different GPU generation against this set reproduces the honest cross-generation floor of 11-12% past the 0.44 gate; see docs/glm-5-3-flash-gpu-profile.md.
